summary: Verified mobile fix for SalesTicker overlapping the sticky Buy CTA. On mobile (390x844), ticker now renders at y=674 (bottom=732) with the sticky bar at y=780 — a clear 48px gap; no overlap. On desktop (1280x800), ticker sits ~24px from bottom (bottom-6) unchanged, and the sticky mobile CTA is correctly hidden. Fix confirmed working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SalesTicker uses `fixed bottom-28 left-4 z-40 sm:bottom-6 sm:left-6`. Verified via bounding box math on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1280x800. Click on sticky-buy did not open a new page in Playwright (route abort + link target behavior) but there was no ticker interception (no overlap). No further action needed.
rca of the issue: SalesTicker previously used `bottom-4` on all viewports. On mobile, the sticky Buy CTA (~90-110px tall) overlapped the toast. Changing base to `bottom-28` (112px) on mobile with `sm:bottom-6` on desktop resolves overlap while preserving desktop layout.
